$comment: Upstream weights Modelado converts to ONNX, each URL pinned to a commit and its license read on 2026-10-24. sha256 is the upstream's own where it publishes one (Hugging Face LFS) and computed from the downloaded file otherwise; size is bytes. scripts/download_models.py reads this file. No weights live in the repository.

models.name: triposr
models.note: TripoSR (Stability AI and Tripo AI): one photo of an object in, a triplane NeRF out, from which a mesh is extracted. The checkpoint holds every weight, the DINO image encoder's included. export_models.py splits it into the encoder (image to triplane) and the decoder (triplane and points to density and colour).

models.name: triposr-config
models.note: The configuration the checkpoint was trained with: cond image 512, triplane 3 x 40 x 64 x 64, radius 0.87.

models.name: dino-vitb16-config
models.note: Only the ViT-B/16 configuration TripoSR's image tokenizer is built from; its weights are in TripoSR's checkpoint.

models.name: depth-anything-v2-small
models.note: Depth Anything V2 Small, relative depth from one photo: the relief operation. Only the Small model is Apache-2.0; Base and Large are CC BY-NC 4.0, so they are not used.

models.name: depth-anything-v2-small-config
models.note: The configuration transformers builds the model from, beside its weights.

models.name: u2net
models.note: U-2-Net, the background remover TripoSR's own run.py uses through rembg, so the object is cut out the way the model was shown it. Already ONNX: 1 x 3 x 320 x 320, out the saliency map.

$comment_test_images: The fixed images export_models.py checks each ONNX export against PyTorch on. Downloaded into test-images/ beside the weights; never committed.

test_images.name: image-chair
test_images.note: 512 x 512 RGBA, already cut out: the object path without background removal.

test_images.name: image-captured
test_images.note: A real phone photo (3024 x 4032) with its background: what background removal and the relief are checked on.
